pages.text:
...ah. You.

I was listening for something else.

Sent. Yes. That is one of the words for it.

I will not fight you and I will not test you. I have never been much good at either,
and the wind does not care which of us is stronger.

What I can give you is height. The Windborne go over the thing instead of through it.
Over walls. Over water. Over most arguments.

Go up. Look east until the harbour stops being a shape and starts being a place.
Something out there has not answered me in a long while. I am not saying it will not.

I have stopped phrasing it as a question. It keeps better that way.

The sentry at the south gate. She writes names down. Let her have yours.
You came back. Most things do not.
